zoe_cs: heads-up — Mimosa Therapeutics private deploy dry-run ran into three short blockers: telemetry egress, KMS key grants, and CloudTrail cross-account write. dropping notes so we can patch the runbook before their cutover on Monday :spiral_notepad:
ben_net: got it. what error did their team see when reaching telemetry?
zoe_cs: connection timed out to telemetry.redwood.ai:443. they had an internal-only destination prefix in their NSG/PT lists. snippet they applied:
```bash
# customer terraform snippet
resource "azurerm_network_security_rule" "allow_telemetry" {
  name                       = "allow-telemetry"
  direction                  = "Outbound"
  access                     = "Allow"
  destination_address_prefix = "10.128.0.0/9" # internal-only, fails to reach public telemetry
  destination_port_range     = "443"
  protocol                   = "Tcp"
}
```
ben_net: ok. runbook should show two options: 1) recommended telemetry CIDR (example public netblock) and 2) VPC endpoint / PrivateLink pattern for zero-egress. i'll add a one-liner verify (curl + tcpdump) to the doc.
nana_sec: KMS issue: their service role was using an org-managed policy that includes "kms:*". flagged by security review. runbook currently has a permissive example; we should replace with least-priv and include `kms:CreateGrant` note for sts temporary creds. also call out rotation cadence implications (quarterly default, monthly requires scheduled rewrap).
mike_platform: can you paste a minimal policy we can drop into the runbook? i'll include it in the PR.
nana_sec: minimal KMS policy (drop-in):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555666777888:key/mimosa-main-key"
    }
  ]
}
```
mike_platform: perfect. note: if they want monthly rotation we need a maintenance plan: rewrap existing envelopes + small index rebuild. mark as potential renewal risk if they insist on monthly without a commit window.
zoe_cs: CloudTrail: forwarding to central bucket failed with AccessDenied. their bucket did not have PutObjectAcl allowed for cross-account principals and object-lock was not enabled as requested by their compliance team. runbook line currently: "enable CloudTrail to central bucket" — too vague.
ben_net: do we have a sample cross-account policy snippet for S3 put from customer account? i'll paste one and we can include common errors.
ben_net: sample S3 bucket policy (central bucket allowing customer's account id 666777888999):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowMimosaPut",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555666777888:root" },
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-audit-central/*"
    }
  ]
}
```
ben_net: prereqs checklist: bucket SSE (aws:kms or AES256) configured, Object Lock enabled with retention >= 1 year, Block Public Access on. common failures: SSE mismatch, missing PutObjectAcl, bucket policy denies s3:PutObjectAcl.
tools-bot: Runbook updated: added placeholders "Telemetry CIDR or PrivateLink", "KMS least-priv policy + CreateGrant note", "CloudTrail cross-account bucket policy + object-lock checklist". Link: /runbooks/mimosa-priv-dryrun (draft).
zoe_cs: next steps: 1) Ben to add verify commands + VPC endpoint snippet, 2) Ana to add KMS rationale + rotation impact, 3) Mike to update runbook and post PR. i'll schedule a 30 minute sync with Mimosa infra tomorrow 11:00 AM PT. tagging account as renewal_watch because they mentioned SLA tied to monthly rotation.
nana_sec: will add a short note: "security preference: avoid kms:CreateGrant in long-lived policies; prefer ephemeral grants via role + CreateGrant during bootstrap" and include `aws kms create-grant` example in appendix.
mike_platform: i'll post PR by EOD and include a short troubleshooting block for CloudTrail AccessDenied (inspect PutObjectAcl, bucket encryption, and bucket policy denies). also adding a one-liner to verify key grants: `aws kms list-grants --key-id <key-id>`.
zoe_cs: thanks all 44d i'll send the invite and include the agenda: 1) confirm telemetry path (CIDR vs PrivateLink) 2) approve KMS policy + rotation cadence 3) validate CloudTrail cross-account plumbing 4) timeline for runbook signoff. once PR is merged we'll run a second dry-run and update renewal status accordingly.
